'''Rion''' is a man from [[Mat Cauthon]]'s memories.

== History ==
Mat remembers that Rion fought at [[Hune Hill]].{{ref/book|14|36}}
==Trivia==
Rion is named for Rion Kinosaki, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
